_comment: Manual fixups for scripts/extract-game-recipes.mjs. Asset names in the cooked game data are internal dev names; most resolve to player-facing names through the localization string tables, but these do not follow any derivable key convention and must be mapped by hand. Verified against the in-game names used by data/recipes.json.
_buildingsComment: The CRC_ collection asset names do not all match the building a player sees. CRC_Refinery/CRC_Pressurizer are swapped relative to their display names (confirmed against the in-game building names and third-party game-data databases), and CRC_Crafter has no string-table entry of its own.
_ignoreBuildingsComment: World-event, scenario and hand-crafting stations. Their recipes duplicate the production-chain ones and are not part of the calculator.
_deprioritizeComment: Used only when no other machine produces the item.
